title: Brown's work witnessed by top government and military figures

tellings.quote: One in which Townsen Brown isn't easily dismissed as an amateur quack. In fact, his work was witnessed by the highest levels of government and military.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on a biography of the researcher Townsend Brown by Paul Shatskin, argues that Brown should not be brushed off as an amateur quack. Michels says Brown's work was witnessed by the highest levels of government and military, naming figures such as the physicist Edward Teller and the businessman Bill Lear. If true, it would mean Brown's work on what is said to be antigravity was taken seriously at the very top.
